newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Matra close to winning Hungary missile deal.
newsitem.headline: Matra close to winning Hungary missile deal.

text.p: Hungary has chosen French company Matra Defence as the prime candidate to supply shoulder-launched anti-aircraft missiles worth some $100 million, but other companies are set to contest the decision, a Defence Ministry spokesman said Thursday
"The deal has not yet been signed, but Matra will be the one with which we will continue negotiations," ministry spokesman Lajos Erdelyi told Reuters.
Hungary, eyeing NATO membership, began last year the process of selecting a supplier for the anti-aircraft missiles and five companies were invited for the second round of bidding.
These were Hughes Electronics Corp., Bombardier Inc. unit Short Brothers of Northern Ireland, Sweden's Bofors, France's Matra and Germany's Daimler-Benz AG.
